evidence.excerpt: We propose CUES (Correlation-gUided Encoder Selection), a lightweight heuristic that estimates complementarity through task- and category-level Pearson correlations between encoders' performance profiles, scoring a candidate set from single-encoder evaluations alone--without fusion training during selection.
